title: Build a little wonder
subtitle: Choose a project, find your parts, and follow one clear step at a time.
kit_note: Match the model and part IDs on your box. Other brands and versions need their own catalogue.
materials_hint: Quantities come from your saved parts box.
reference_only: Based on manufacturer instructions · physical testing not completed
idea_hint: Match your idea to one of the projects supported by this kit.
placeholder: I want to make a little light…
ai_scope: New functions need an additional supported project.
ai_unavailable: AI matching is not configured. You can still choose and build a project above.
shelf_hint: Save the quantities you actually have. This list covers the supported projects, not every part in the kit.
empty: Your first project will appear here.
error: We could not finish this action. Please try again.
unsupported: This kit does not yet support that idea. Choose one of the projects above.
validation_failed: This project could not pass the checks. Check your parts quantities or choose another project.
progress_conflict: Progress changed on another screen. The latest progress has been requested; try again.
catalog_changed: The parts catalogue has changed. Refresh the page before starting.
board_hint: Rows A–G and columns 1–10 match the base grid. Dashed outlines mark this step; lower layers stay visible.
checked: An adult and I checked the part IDs, plugs or snap layers, and battery directions against the complete diagram.
reported_worked: You reported that it worked. This records your observation; it is not a platform hardware test.
reported_help: You reported that you need help. Switch off and check the troubleshooting steps below with an adult.
observation_unknown: A newer observation was saved. Reopen this project with an updated app.
pan_diagram: Swipe sideways to inspect the enlarged diagram.
box_import: I have this kit — check its parts
box_check: I checked the model, part markings and quantities against my real kit. Missing parts are set to zero.
box_parent: A parent can update the parts box after leaving child mode.
box_before_start: Check and save your parts box before starting a project.
box_save_error: The parts box could not be saved. Your edits are still here. If another screen changed it, cancel these edits and open the latest quantities.
inventory_conflict: Your parts box changed. Check the latest quantities before continuing.
purchase: Where to get this kit and replacement parts
purchase_note: Confirm the exact model and included parts with the seller. A purchase link does not confirm stock or compatibility.
module_board_hint: Simplified connection diagram: match the printed module IDs and socket arrows. It is not a mounting scale. Cable arrows show signal direction; the cables also carry power.
box_before_trial: Finish the steps before trying your project.
trial_note: Record what your family actually tried. These reports stay separate from platform hardware validation and never change the saved design.
trial_hardware: Model and markings on your actual kit
trial_observed: What happened? Note any changes or problems.
trial_check: An adult checked the assembly and this report describes a real trial.
trial_saved: Trial saved as a family report.
trial_finish: Save progress through the final step before recording a trial.
